findings.title: Autonomous Background Finalization Infrastructure & Route Handler
findings.description: In Phase 11, finalizeOverdueAttempts existed only as a domain function and local test script without an authenticated production endpoint or deployment cron configuration.
findings.resolution: Implemented /api/cron/finalize-overdue-attempts and alias /api/cron/finalize-overdue with Bearer token authentication, structured JSON telemetry logging, and HTTP 500 error reporting for external scheduler retry handling. Configured vercel.json 1-minute schedule. Validated across 7 dedicated test specifications in tests/scheduler-finalization.test.mjs.

findings.title: Candidate Privilege Restriction on Maintenance Sweep Action
findings.description: The server action finalizeOverdueAttemptsAction previously accepted any authenticated student session, permitting an unprivileged candidate to trigger database-wide finalization across other candidates' attempts.
findings.resolution: Hardened finalizeOverdueAttemptsAction with assertAdminSession(). Unprivileged candidate calls are strictly rejected with 401/403 (MCQJ-ERR-4001 / MCQJ-ERR-4003). Validated via test SCHED-04.

findings.title: Prisma CLI Isolation & Migration History Sync
findings.description: prisma.config.ts previously used dotenv with override: true, causing local CLI commands to overwrite process.env.DIRECT_URL with remote Supabase credentials. Additionally, local test setup previously loaded SQL files directly without generating _prisma_migrations records.
findings.resolution: Updated prisma.config.ts to preserve explicit process environment variables prior to dotenv loading. Updated scripts/bootstrap-test-db.mjs to execute npx prisma migrate deploy, creating official _prisma_migrations ledger locally. Verified with npx prisma migrate status returning 'Database schema is up to date!'.

findings.title: Next.js 16 cacheComponents Turbopack Route Segment Compatibility
findings.description: Exporting 'export const dynamic = force-dynamic' inside route handlers failed Turbopack production compilation under Next.js 16 when cacheComponents is enabled.
findings.resolution: Removed deprecated export const dynamic statement from cron route handler and utilized standard Next.js 16 await connection() with ESM-compliant next/server.js import. Verified with npm run build compiling all 23 routes cleanly.

limitations.description: Zero database mutations were executed against remote hosted Supabase Staging. Application of the 10 forward-only migrations via 'npx prisma migrate deploy' on the hosted PostgreSQL instance requires explicit human authorization and execution according to STAGING_RUNBOOK.md.

The cron route handler /api/cron/finalize-overdue-attempts fails closed (HTTP 500) if CRON_SECRET is not configured in hosting provider environment variables. CRON_SECRET must be securely generated and added to Vercel/Doppler project settings before activating scheduled sweeps.
